mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting from tightening to easing, lowering discount rates and increasing equity valuation sensitivity, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a sudden discount rate hike, reducing the present value of expected equity cash flows and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs signals a strengthening labor market, prompting firms to increase investment in productive capacity and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 150,000 jobs indicates labor market weakness, prompting firms to cut investment and reducing equity valuation, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in retail sales (HOUST) above 2% suggests resilient consumer demand, prompting firms to raise investment and lift equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 points indicates supply-side constraints, prompting firms to prioritize cost-cutting and reducing equity valuation, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in constraint periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in retail sales (HOUST) below 1% signals waning consumer demand, prompting firms to reduce investment and equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in demand periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% indicates a strengthening labor market, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain or cut rates, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
